name: webchart-oauth-example
description: A Node.js application for WebChart FHIR interface with OAuth2 authentication

scripts.start: bash -c 'select opt in "Default app" "OpenID app"; do case $opt in "Default app") concurrently --kill-others --success first "node webchart-example.js"; break;; "OpenID app") concurrently --kill-others --success first "node webchart-example_openid.mjs"; break;; esac; done'
scripts.test: bash -c 'if [ "$TEST_TYPE" == "openid" ]; then concurrently --kill-others --success first "node webchart-example_openid.mjs" "node puppeteer-test_openid.js"; elif [ "$TEST_TYPE" == "default" ]; then concurrently --kill-others --success first "node webchart-example.js" "node puppeteer-test.js"; else select opt in "Default Test" "OpenID Test"; do case $opt in "Default Test") concurrently --kill-others --success first "node webchart-example.js" "node puppeteer-test.js"; break;; "OpenID Test") concurrently --kill-others --success first "node webchart-example_openid.mjs" "node puppeteer-test_openid.js"; break;; esac; done; fi'
